# Remote targets

USB is the default, but frida-server can listen on TCP too. This is how we
reach devices that adb does not reach, or a frida-server running inside a
container.

## 1. Listen on the network

On the emulator, restart frida-server with a bind address:

```bash
$ adb shell 'pkill frida-server; sleep 1; /data/local/tmp/frida-server -D -l 0.0.0.0:27042 &'
```

`-l 0.0.0.0:27042` makes it listen on every interface, port 27042.

## 2. Reach it from the host

The emulator forwards its own ports through adb. On the host:

```bash
$ adb forward tcp:27042 tcp:27042
27042
```

Now `127.0.0.1:27042` on the host is the emulator's frida-server.

## 3. List processes remotely

```text
[0x00000000]> fridapj frida://list/remote/127.0.0.1:27042/
{"ok":true,"result":{"processes":[{"pid":1,"name":"init"},...,{"pid":2812,"name":"FridaMin"}],"total":104}}
```

![Remote process list](img/remote_access/remote-processes.png)

## 4. Attach remotely

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaoj frida://attach/remote/127.0.0.1:27042/FridaMin
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","pid":2812,"resumed":false,"state":"attached"}}

[0x00000000]> fridaij
{"ok":true,"result":{"version":1,"platform":"linux","arch":"x64","pointerSize":8}}
```

![Remote attach](img/remote_access/remote-attach.png)

Everything works as over USB: the transport is transparent once the session
is open.

## 5. Fast failures

frida's remote connect has no socket timeout of its own. rz-frida opens a
short throwaway TCP connection first, bounded by `frida.timeout`, so an
unreachable host fails quickly and a Ctrl-C aborts it:

```text
[0x00000000]> fridapj frida://list/remote/192.0.2.1:27042/
{"ok":false,"error":{"code":"timeout","message":"Could not connect to 192.0.2.1: Socket I/O timed out"}}
```

Without the probe the same command would hang for the TCP retry period
(tens of seconds). The probe covers listing and session commands alike.

> **Note:** the forward dies with adb restarts and emulator reboots.
> Re-run `adb forward tcp:27042 tcp:27042` after each boot.

::: {.callout-tip}
### Try

Restart frida-server with `-l 0.0.0.0:27042`, forward the port, list
processes remotely, attach and close.
:::
